caption: This shoyu ramen features a clear, amber broth with tender chashu pork, nori, menma, and naruto fish cake arranged atop. Served in a white bowl with “絹屋” branding, it rests on a dark tray under warm, inviting light.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture beneath the bowl.
Chashu pork: tender, thinly sliced, with golden-brown sear, curved shape, and visible marbling on its surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, slightly curled, with a rough, uneven surface and visible texture from its dried, layered structure.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and clear, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear golden-brown, with fibrous texture and irregular, slightly curved, segmented shapes.
White ceramic ramen bowl with glossy finish, smooth curved rim, and black Japanese characters with red seal mark.
Naruto fish cake: pale beige, slightly translucent, oval-shaped with pink and green swirls on its surface.
